//: Claude Desktop MCP config for Fixora. Copy this block into claude_desktop_config.json and replace the command path with your install location (default: C:\Users\<you>\AppData\Local\Programs\Fixora\Fixora.exe).
//1: Enable MCP first: open Fixora → Settings → MCP Server → 'Allow external tools (MCP)'. Off by default, and the server refuses to serve without it.
//2: `--mcp` starts a headless MCP-only process — no window, no dock icon. It runs INDEPENDENTLY of a running Fixora instance: you can have the app open and Claude Desktop spawning this at the same time.
//3: The MCP process exits when its client closes the pipe, so Claude Desktop owns its lifetime.
